_about: Fixed Ordinary of the Holy Eucharist (Common Worship Order One) as used at Prince of Peace, Putrajaya. EN is authoritative (transcribed verbatim from the parish service booklet). BM is a DRAFT in reverent Anglican register and must be vetted against the Diocese of West Malaysia's authorised BM texts before use. Items with empty bm ("") still need translation; the generator flags them.

lines.en: Alleluia. Christ is risen.
lines.bm: Haleluya. Kristus telah bangkit.

lines.en: He is risen indeed. Alleluia!
lines.bm: Sesungguhnya Dia telah bangkit. Haleluya!

lines.en: The Lord be with you.
lines.bm: Tuhan menyertai kamu.

lines.en: And also with you.
lines.bm: Dan menyertai kamu juga.

lines.en:
Almighty God,
to whom all hearts are open,
all desires known,
and from whom no secrets are hidden:
cleanse the thoughts of our hearts
by the inspiration of your Holy Spirit,
that we may perfectly love you,
and worthily magnify your holy name,
through Christ our Lord.
Amen.
lines.bm:
Allah Yang Maha Kuasa,
yang kepada-Mu segala hati terbuka,
segala keinginan diketahui,
dan daripada-Mu tiada rahsia tersembunyi:
sucikanlah fikiran hati kami
oleh ilham Roh Kudus-Mu,
supaya kami dapat mengasihi-Mu dengan sempurna,
dan memuliakan nama-Mu yang kudus dengan selayaknya,
melalui Kristus Tuhan kami.
Amin.

lines.en: Lord, have mercy.
lines.bm: Tuhan, kasihanilah kami.

lines.en: Lord, have mercy.
lines.bm: Tuhan, kasihanilah kami.

lines.en: Christ, have mercy.
lines.bm: Kristus, kasihanilah kami.

lines.en: Christ, have mercy.
lines.bm: Kristus, kasihanilah kami.

lines.en: Lord, have mercy.
lines.bm: Tuhan, kasihanilah kami.

lines.en: Lord, have mercy.
lines.bm: Tuhan, kasihanilah kami.

lines.en:
Glory to God in the highest,
and peace to his people on earth.
lines.bm:
Kemuliaan bagi Allah di tempat yang maha tinggi,
dan damai sejahtera di bumi bagi umat-Nya.

lines.en:
Lord God, heavenly King,
almighty God and Father,
we worship you, we give you thanks,
we praise you for your glory.
lines.bm:
Ya Tuhan Allah, Raja syurgawi,
Allah Bapa Yang Maha Kuasa,
kami menyembah-Mu, kami mengucap syukur kepada-Mu,
kami memuji-Mu kerana kemuliaan-Mu.

lines.en:
Lord Jesus Christ, only Son of the Father,
Lord God, Lamb of God,
you take away the sin of the world:
have mercy on us;
you are seated at the right hand of the Father:
receive our prayer.
lines.bm:
Ya Tuhan Yesus Kristus, Putera Bapa yang tunggal,
Ya Tuhan Allah, Anak Domba Allah,
Engkau menghapuskan dosa dunia:
kasihanilah kami;
Engkau yang duduk di sebelah kanan Bapa:
terimalah doa kami.

lines.en:
For you alone are the Holy One,
you alone are the Lord,
you alone are the Most High, Jesus Christ,
with the Holy Spirit,
in the glory of God the Father.
Amen.
lines.bm:
Kerana hanya Engkau Yang Kudus,
hanya Engkau Tuhan,
hanya Engkau Yang Maha Tinggi, ya Yesus Kristus,
bersama Roh Kudus,
dalam kemuliaan Allah Bapa.
Amin.

lines.en:
We believe in one God,
the Father, the Almighty,
maker of heaven and earth,
of all that is, seen and unseen.
lines.bm:
Kami percaya kepada satu Allah,
Bapa Yang Maha Kuasa,
pencipta langit dan bumi,
segala yang kelihatan dan tidak kelihatan.

lines.en:
We believe in one Lord, Jesus Christ,
the only Son of God,
eternally begotten of the Father,
God from God, Light from Light,
true God from true God,
begotten, not made,
of one Being with the Father;
through him all things were made.

For us and for our salvation
he came down from heaven,
was incarnate from the Holy Spirit and the Virgin Mary
and was made man.
For our sake he was crucified under Pontius Pilate;
he suffered death and was buried.
On the third day he rose again
in accordance with the Scriptures;
he ascended into heaven
and is seated at the right hand of the Father.

He will come again in glory
to judge the living and the dead,
and his kingdom will have no end.

We believe in the Holy Spirit,
the Lord, the giver of life,
who proceeds from the Father and the Son,
who with the Father and the Son
is worshipped and glorified,
who has spoken through the prophets.

We believe in one holy catholic and apostolic Church.
We acknowledge one baptism for the forgiveness of sins.
We look for the resurrection of the dead,
and the life of the world to come.
Amen.

Almighty God, our heavenly Father,
we have sinned against you
and against our fellow men,
in thought and word and deed,
through negligence, through weakness,
through our own deliberate fault.
We are truly sorry and repent of all our sins.
For the sake of your Son, Jesus Christ,
who died for us, forgive us all that is past;
and grant that we may serve you in newness of life
to the glory of your Name. Amen.
lines.bm:
Allah Yang Maha Kuasa, Bapa kami di syurga,
kami telah berdosa terhadap-Mu
dan terhadap sesama kami,
dalam fikiran, perkataan dan perbuatan,
kerana kelalaian, kerana kelemahan,
kerana kesalahan kami sendiri.
Kami benar-benar menyesal dan bertaubat daripada segala dosa kami.
Demi Putera-Mu, Yesus Kristus,
yang telah mati untuk kami, ampunilah segala yang telah lalu;
dan kurniakanlah supaya kami melayani-Mu dalam hidup yang baru
bagi kemuliaan nama-Mu. Amin.

lines.en:
Almighty God,
who forgives all who truly repent,
have mercy upon you,
pardon and deliver you from all your sins,
confirm and strengthen you in all goodness,
and keep you in life eternal;
through Jesus Christ our Lord.
lines.bm:
Allah Yang Maha Kuasa,
yang mengampuni semua yang benar-benar bertaubat,
kasihanilah kamu,
ampunilah dan lepaskanlah kamu daripada segala dosamu,
teguhkanlah dan kuatkanlah kamu dalam segala kebaikan,
dan peliharalah kamu dalam hidup yang kekal;
melalui Yesus Kristus Tuhan kami.

lines.en: Amen.
lines.bm: Amin.

lines.en: The peace of the Lord be with you.
lines.bm: Damai Tuhan menyertai kamu.

lines.en: And also with you.
lines.bm: Dan menyertai kamu juga.

lines.en:
Yours, Lord, is the greatness, the power, the glory,
the splendour, and the majesty;
for everything in heaven and on earth is yours.
All things come from you,
and of your own do we give you.
lines.bm:
Ya Tuhan, milik-Mulah kebesaran, kuasa, kemuliaan,
keagungan, dan kedaulatan;
kerana segala yang di langit dan di bumi adalah milik-Mu.
Segala sesuatu datang daripada-Mu,
dan daripada milik-Mu sendiri kami persembahkan kepada-Mu.

lines.en: The Lord be with you.
lines.bm: Tuhan menyertai kamu.

lines.en: And also with you.
lines.bm: Dan menyertai kamu juga.

lines.en: Lift up your hearts.
lines.bm: Marilah mengangkat hati.

lines.en: We lift them to the Lord.
lines.bm: Kami mengangkatnya kepada Tuhan.

lines.en: Let us give thanks to the Lord our God.
lines.bm: Marilah mengucap syukur kepada Tuhan Allah kita.

lines.en: It is right to give him thanks and praise.
lines.bm: Sungguh layak mengucap syukur dan memuji Dia.

lines.en:
Holy, holy, holy Lord,
God of power and might,
heaven and earth are full of your glory.
Hosanna in the highest.
Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.
Hosanna in the highest.
lines.bm:
Kudus, kudus, kuduslah Tuhan,
Allah segala kuasa,
langit dan bumi penuh dengan kemuliaan-Mu.
Hosana di tempat yang maha tinggi.
Diberkatilah Dia yang datang dalam nama Tuhan.
Hosana di tempat yang maha tinggi.

lines.en:
Christ has died.
Christ is risen.
Christ will come again.
lines.bm:
Kristus telah mati.
Kristus telah bangkit.
Kristus akan datang kembali.

lines.en:
Our Father in heaven,
hallowed be your name,
your kingdom come,
your will be done,
on earth as in heaven.
Give us today our daily bread.
Forgive us our sins
as we forgive those who sin against us.
Lead us not into temptation
but deliver us from evil.
For the kingdom, the power, and the glory are yours
now and for ever.
Amen.
lines.bm:
Ya Bapa kami yang di syurga,
dikuduskanlah nama-Mu,
datanglah kerajaan-Mu,
jadilah kehendak-Mu,
di bumi seperti di syurga.
Berikanlah kami pada hari ini makanan kami yang secukupnya.
Dan ampunilah kami akan dosa kami,
seperti kami mengampuni orang yang bersalah kepada kami.
Dan janganlah membawa kami ke dalam pencubaan,
tetapi lepaskanlah kami daripada yang jahat.
Kerana Engkaulah yang empunya kerajaan, kuasa dan kemuliaan
sekarang dan selama-lamanya.
Amin.

lines.en: We break this bread to share in the body of Christ.
lines.bm: Kami memecahkan roti ini untuk mengambil bahagian dalam tubuh Kristus.

lines.en:
Though we are many, we are one body,
because we all share in one bread.
lines.bm:
Walaupun kami ramai, kami satu tubuh,
kerana kami semua mengambil bahagian dalam satu roti.

lines.en:
We do not presume to come to this your table,
merciful Lord,
trusting in our own righteousness,
but in your manifold and great mercies.
We are not worthy so much as to gather up the crumbs under your table.
But you are the same Lord whose nature is always to have mercy.
Grant us therefore, gracious Lord,
so to eat the flesh of your dear Son Jesus Christ
and to drink his blood,
that we may evermore dwell in him and he in us. Amen.

Jesus, Lamb of God, have mercy on us.
Jesus, bearer of our sins, have mercy on us.
Jesus, redeemer of the world, give us your peace.
lines.bm:
Yesus, Anak Domba Allah, kasihanilah kami.
Yesus, penanggung dosa kami, kasihanilah kami.
Yesus, Penebus dunia, kurniakanlah damai-Mu kepada kami.

lines.en:
Almighty God, we thank you for feeding us
with the body and blood of your Son Jesus Christ.
Through him we offer you our souls and bodies
to be a living sacrifice.
Send us out in the power of your Spirit
to live and work to your praise and glory.
Amen.
lines.bm:
Allah Yang Maha Kuasa, kami mengucap syukur kerana Engkau memberi kami makan
dengan tubuh dan darah Putera-Mu Yesus Kristus.
Melalui Dia kami mempersembahkan jiwa dan tubuh kami
sebagai korban yang hidup.
Utuslah kami keluar dalam kuasa Roh-Mu
untuk hidup dan bekerja bagi pujian dan kemuliaan-Mu.
Amin.

lines.en: Go in peace to love and serve the Lord.
lines.bm: Pergilah dengan sejahtera untuk mengasihi dan melayani Tuhan.

lines.en: In the name of Christ. Amen.
lines.bm: Dalam nama Kristus. Amin.
